name: archify
description: Create polished, validated architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, and lifecycle diagrams as explorable standalone HTML.

interface.longDescription: Archify turns a codebase or system description into a polished, interactive technical map. Typed JSON IR and deterministic checks produce self-contained HTML plus PNG, SVG, WebM, and share cards.
defaultPrompt: Use archify to map this repository's runtime architecture
Draw this login flow as an Archify sequence diagram
Compare two architecture snapshots as Before / Delta / After
